Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Dezvoltare de software
Position: C++ Embedded Software Engineer
 Location: On-Site (Iasi, Romania)
 Seniority: Mid-Senior Level
 Language: English
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for experienced C++ Embedded Software Engineers to join a cross-functional feature team that delivers software across multiple subsystems. This is an on-site position , based in Iasi.
 The role requires solid hands-on experience in modern C++ (C++17 or later) , with a focus on Qt desktop applications and/or real-time systems such as QNX , as well as Embedded Linux and Windows IoT / kiosk environments . You will take ownership of features end-to-end, from understanding and design through implementation, testing and integration, working closely with the Technical Anchor / Architect and the client’s engineering teams.
 The role also requires the active use of Agentic AI as part of the software engineering and development workflow. Previous experience in a safety-critical or regulated environment , such as automotive or medical devices , is considered an advantage.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Feature Development & Ownership 
Design, develop and maintain features across multiple components and subsystems
Analyze existing code, data flows and dependencies before proposing changes
Prepare technical designs and align them with the Architect and module owners before implementation
Take end-to-end ownership of delivered features and explain your implementation choices during code reviews
 C++ & Embedded Development 
Develop high-quality software using modern C++ (C++17 or later)
Build and extend desktop GUI applications with Qt
Develop applications for Windows IoT / kiosk environments
Develop embedded applications for Linux
Develop or support software running on QNX real-time operating systems
Ensure performance, reliability, and maintainability across supported platforms
 Quality & Testing 
Work within a defined, regulated Software Development Process, similar to those used in automotive (ASPICE / ISO 26262) or medical device (IEC 62304) projects
Maintain traceability between requirements, design, implementation and tests, along with the documentation required for verification and compliance
Apply Test-Driven Development and write maintainable unit tests
Work within CI quality gates: static analysis (clang-tidy), formatting (clang-format), warnings-as-errors, Doxygen documentation
Support integration and validation on real hardware together with integration and test engineers
 Agentic AI & Engineering Efficiency 
Actively use Agentic AI (e.g. GitHub Copilot agent mode) within software engineering and development workflows
Drive AI tools responsibly: review, understand and own all AI-generated code
 Technical Requirements 
 Must-have 
4+ years of professional software development experience in modern C++ (C++17 or later)
Hands-on experience with Qt or QNX / other RTOS
Experience developing applications for embedded Linux and/or Windows IoT / kiosk environments
Experience with unit testing and static analysis tools
Active hands-on use of Agentic AI in software engineering and development workflows
Good knowledge of Git and CI/CD workflows
Fluent English communication skills
 Nice-to-have 
Previous experience developing software in a safety-critical or regulated environment, such as automotive (ISO 26262 / ASPICE) or industrial (IEC 61508); MedTech / Medical Devices experience under IEC 62304 (Class B or C) is a strong advantage
Familiarity with FDA regulations for medical device software (e.g. 21 CFR Part 11)
Experience with both Qt and QNX / other RTOS
Familiarity with FPGA development (Xilinx or Intel toolchains)
Experience with CMake and the Conan 2 package manager
Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) YAML pipelines and Artifactory integration
Knowledge of server-side development, including REST APIs and containerisation
 Soft Skills 
High level of responsibility and ownership for the code you deliver
Analytical and structured problem-solving skills
Ability to explain technical solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong collaboration skills within cross-functional, on-site teams
Proactive and solution-oriented mindset
 Education 
University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, Electronics Engineering, or a related field
